senses.gloss:
भोक्तृ a. [भुज् तृच्]
—1 One who enjoys or eats.
—2 Possessing.
—3 Enjoying or making use of.
—4 Feeling, enduring, experiencing.
—5 Protecting, ruling, governing. ━m.
—1 A possessor, enjoyer, user; पुरुषोऽस्ति भोक्तृभावात् कैवल्यार्थप्रवृत्तेश्च Sāṅ. K. 17.
—2 A husband.
—3 A king, ruler.
—4 A lover.
—5 An epithet of Viṣṇu.

—1 Being a possessor.
—2 Enjoyment, possession.
—3 Perception.
